question: What is the meaning of tools in relation to transportation and logistics?
description: Tools in relation to transportation and logistics refer to the equipment or resources necessary for the efficient movement and handling of materials and products throughout the supply chain. These tools can include items such as machinery, containers, packaging materials, or any other physical instruments that aid in the transportation process.
